content_text:
With Mann as a specific reference, I assume you’ve checked out
Heat
– if not, bump that to the top of your list. Style serves the story, and it basically establishes a lot of the grammar for a lot of the neo-noirs to follow.
Not exactly in the genre, but using an aesthetic that is pretty simpatico: Scorsese’s
After Hours
, which was his first collaboration with Michael Ballhaus (I think). Ballhaus has strong ties to the New German Cinema movement, too, which makes a nice connection to Wenders.
How did the shoot go, by the way?
